note: Every Build 15 audit finding with the fields of spec §4. kind: defect (has a severity), review (no defect found), claim (external claim checked). Kept in step with audit.md by test_audit_findings.py. B15-DL-03 is added with the season-pause pull request (#28), which holds its audit row.

findings.evidence: [section, section#0, section] produced section#0 twice with the original helper; 20,000 random lists after the fix
findings.root_cause: Generated suffixes did not reserve real keys shaped like generated ones
findings.user_impact: A list screen (home, search) can crash
alternatives: Reserve all original keys and skip taken suffixes
findings.compatibility: Nuvio file: registered in features.json; small diff

findings.evidence: Scaling run: 60 KB malformed file 5.2 s, 1 MB minutes; 60,000-file old/new comparison equal on well-formed input
findings.root_cause: Rescanning the rest of the file from every position on unclosed tags (quadratic)
findings.user_impact: A malformed add-on subtitle freezes download preparation or the subtitle list
findings.rationale: Fixes the cause without changing well-formed output

findings.evidence: Code review: size cap, empty-file check, ASCII cache name, decoding on IO inside runCatching
findings.user_impact: None found

findings.evidence: One copy per import in cache/device-subtitles, never removed (code review)
findings.user_impact: Cache grows with each import until Android clears it
alternatives: Remove earlier processes' copies on import
Leave to the OS cache trimming
findings.rationale: Device subtitles are never stored as preferences, so nothing references old copies

findings.evidence: Code review of executeToFolder (K-03)
findings.root_cause: Free-space check uses stored progress after the .part document was deleted outside the app
findings.user_impact: A download can start without enough space and fail later; no data loss
alternatives: Re-read the document size before the check
findings.rationale: Needs a SAF provider test to change safely

findings.evidence: CI teardown: 'No url found for submodule path libass-android'
findings.root_cause: Gitlinks without .gitmodules entries in Nuvio's tree
findings.user_impact: None at runtime; noise in CI logs
findings.rationale: Changing Nuvio's tree adds sync conflicts for no runtime gain

findings.evidence: Code review only: runBlocking reads of Compose resources
findings.root_cause: Synchronous resource reads on the calling thread
findings.user_impact: Possible jank; not measured

findings.evidence: LocalSubtitleSyncCuesTest: local file and HTTP
findings.root_cause: Offline early return in loadSubtitleAutoSyncCues blocked local files without network
findings.user_impact: Manual sync of a device subtitle fails offline
alternatives: Skip the offline return for file: URIs
Copy the file to memory first
findings.chosen: Skip the offline return for local files
findings.rationale: Smallest change; iOS has no file: path (deferred)
refs: NEEDS PHYSICAL DEVICE for the device check

findings.evidence: updateSubtitleGesture saved 12 settings about sixty times per second of dragging
findings.root_cause: Every frame persisted the whole style
findings.user_impact: Storage churn and possible stutter while moving subtitles
alternatives: Live preview, one save at gesture end
findings.rationale: Saves exactly the final value, also on cancel or dispose
refs: NEEDS PHYSICAL DEVICE for the feel
